sentences.text: Simblaspis was an extinct genus of arthrodire placoderm fish that lived during the Early Devonian period.
This creature is considered one of the most basal members of the order Arthrodira and is closely related to the genus Aleosteus.
The type species of Simblaspis — the specimen the species is based on — was originally described in 1958 from Pragian strata in the Qasr Limestone of Saudi Arabia.
Simblaspis belongs to the family Actinolepididae.
It is classified within the class Placodermi.
Simblaspis lived between the Lochkovian and Emsian stages, approximately 419.62 to 393.47 million years ago.
